The blue background is a removable mask and must not reflect blue light onto the asset.

Specific design: A wall-height slab-like mass of natural limestone: about 7 ft wide, 10 ft tall and 3.5 ft deep (a thick upright slab, clearly taller than wide and much wider than deep).
